Making the invitation easier to find

Mock only, drawn on the real local page (tidewatcher / tidewatch, private). Each option is visible to the Owner and Admins on private repositories only.

A · Invite button, popover open (recommended)

Next to Star on every tab. The popover shows the code with Copy and links to Members for Rotate and Revoke.

A · Invite button, no code yet

The same popover offers Create code.

A · Invite button, dark

B · Invite card in the side panel

Always visible above About; Copy sits under the code because the panel is narrow.

C · Banner under the tabs

The loudest option; fits best while the Owner is the only member.
